_about: THE PLAYGROUND EDITOR'S PROGRESSION (Palle, 2026-11-06: "at the point floor we can only add points. Then one triangle floor we can add triangles and quad. When we add a quad we can start to add things on the place when we have added full quads, like health and danger. Then we can add more and more stuff but not from all artifacts and in the menu we should have an icon for the thing we can add at that level"). One table drives both the jumbotron's tiles and what the glass box accepts (commons/artifacts/scaffold_workstation/display.gd, space mode). A tool is open on a station whose `space_floor` is at or past its `from_floor`; later tools show dark with the floor that opens them. `kinds` are the construction record's kinds (model.gd) the tool lays; `item` is an inventory item (commons/data/inventory/items.json) placed onto a finished horizontal quad. Edit by hand.
